description: OpenAI's academic research programme will give eligible faculty members and postdoctoral researchers at selected Indian institutions a year of free ChatGPT Plus access. Each grant includes three accounts, and applications are scheduled to open on November 30. Researchers can use the service for literature reviews, data analysis, hypothesis development and research writing, with training and support also included. The India offer is part of a global expansion involving 50,000 additional grants. The initial pilot has attracted 20,000 researchers across 33 countries.
title: OpenAI Expands ChatGPT for Academic Researchers Programme to India With Free Plus Access

description: Xiaomi 18 Pro Max and Xiaomi 18 Pro have been launched in select global markets, the company announced on Tuesday. Both flagship models are now on sale in select global markets via the Xiaomi online store. The Xiaomi 18 Pro and Xiaomi 18 Pro Max are offered in Black, Cosmic Blue, Velvet Red, and White colour options. The Xiaomi 18 Pro and Xiaomi 18 Pro Max run the company’s latest HyperOS 4, which is based on Android 17. Moreover, the Xiaomi 18 Pro and Xiaomi 18 Pro Max are equipped with 2.7-inch (596 x 912 pixels) and 2.9-inch (596 x 976 pixels) AMOLED touchscreens, offering up to a 120Hz refresh rate. Powering the Xiaomi 18 Pro is the octa-core Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 SoC. Meanwhile, the Xiaomi 18 Pro Max boasts the Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chipset, which is built on a 2nm process, delivering a peak clock speed of up to 5.01GHz.
title: Xiaomi 18 Pro Max, Xiaomi 18 Pro Launched Globally With Privacy Display, Dual 200-Megapixel Cameras: Price, Features

description: OpenAI is working with healthcare organisations to use AI agents for tasks that involve switching between clinical and administrative systems. A demonstration showed an agent reviewing patient records and preparing paperwork for an MRI referral, while CVS Health and Cigna Healthcare are using the technology in their operations. OpenAI reported safety and usefulness ratings from clinician assessments, alongside benchmark scores for two models. The tools include access controls and approval settings, and are offered through its API and healthcare products.
title: OpenAI Brings Computer-Use AI Agents to Healthcare for Medical Records and Insurance Workflows

description: Pump.fun has integrated Polymarket prediction markets into its mobile app, allowing eligible users to trade event contracts alongside cryptocurrencies. The feature covers sports, esports, commodities, and crypto prices. Users can sell positions before an event concludes or hold them until resolution. The platform also plans to extend its Callout Rewards programme to prediction markets.
title: Pump.fun Adds Prediction Markets as It Looks Beyond Memecoin Trading

description: Sony is rolling out a new system software update for PS5 just before the launch of Grand Theft Auto 6. The PlayStation website says that the PS5 system software version 26.07-14.23.00 includes “some security fixes to the system software.” The update arrives amidst numerous attempts to jailbreak the PS5 firmware.
title: Sony Rolls Out New PS5 System Software Update With 'Security Fixes' Ahead of GTA 6 Launch

description: Former Robinhood software engineer Huaisong Xiang has pleaded guilty to wire fraud after earning $125,500 by trading Hyperliquid perpetual futures using confidential information about upcoming cryptocurrency listings on Robinhood. Prosecutors said he traded ahead of public announcements between 2025 and 2026. Xiang has agreed to forfeit his gains, while another former engineer, Hefu Chai, was also charged in connection with the alleged scheme.
title: Ex-Robinhood Engineer Admits Guilt in $125,000 Hyperliquid Fraud Case

description: Google is splitting privacy controls in the Gemini app. The tech giant is separating chat history from AI training permissions so users can retain their history without allowing Google to train models on their data. The revised privacy settings are scheduled to roll out gradually over the coming weeks.
title: Gemini Users Can Now Save Their Chat History Without Opting in to AI Model Training

description: Samsung is said to be exploring a new display design that could significantly reduce the bezels around its upcoming flagship Galaxy smartphones. According to a report, the South Korean tech conglomerate could introduce an almost bezel-free screen, potentially with a quad-curved design that extends towards all four edges. Samsung is reportedly considering bringing the display to select flagship models before similar technologies are adopted by other smartphone makers in their respective flagships.
title: Samsung Reportedly Developing Almost Bezel-Free Display for Future Galaxy Flagships

description: WhatsApp is reportedly testing native cloud backup storage for select Android beta testers. It was spotted in WhatsApp beta for Android version 2.26.46.4. This functionality provides 2GB of free cloud storage. Chats stored on WhatsApp’s native cloud are end-to-end encrypted by default. Users requiring additional capacity can opt for higher tiers via a WhatsApp Plus subscription to get up to 100GB. Meta One tiers can scale storage allocation up to 4TB.
title: WhatsApp Rolling Out Cloud Storage for Chat Backups on Android: Report

description: EvoFox Play V wireless gamepad has been launched in India, Amkette announced on Tuesday. Amkette’s latest EvoFox Play V is a wireless gamepad that is compatible with Sony’s PS5 Slim, PS5 Fat, and PS5 Pro, along with digital and disc editions, laptops and PCs running Windows, and smartphones. The new gaming controller supports Bluetooth 5.0 and a USB Type-C port for wireless and wired connectivity, respectively. In wireless mode, it has an operating range of less than 10m. The EvoFox Play V is equipped with two joysticks with Magnetic Hall 3D anti-drift technology. The gaming controller also has a six-axis gyroscope with an accelerometer to enable motion controls.
title: EvoFox Play V Wireless Gamepad Launched in India With Magnetic Hall 3D Joysticks for Sony’s PS5, PC and Smartphones

description: Oppo's rumoured Find X11 Pro Max could feature a display with exceptionally narrow borders, according to a new leak. The design is said to combine a flat screen panel with glass that curves towards the frame on all four sides. The tipster also suggested that the manufacturing costs could restrict the technology to premium flagship models. The upcoming phone has previously been linked to a 200-megapixel rear camera and a 100-megapixel front camera, based on hardware from the cancelled Find X10 Ultra.
title: Oppo Find X11 Pro Max Tipped to Get Flat Screen, Quad-Curved Glass

description: iQOO Z12 Lite has been added to the list of supported devices of the Google Play Console with the model number I2510. In terms of design, the iQOO Z12 Lite is expected to sport a flat display, along with a waterdrop-style notch, which might house a camera for selfies and video calls. Moreover, the power button and volume controls appear on the right side of the iQOO Z12 Lite. Meanwhile, the left side of the handset could be left clean. It is shown to feature relatively thick bezels and a chin. The phone will reportedly be powered by an octa-core MediaTek Dimensity 6300 chipset, featuring six efficiency cores clocked at 2.0GHz and two performance cores, delivering a peak clock speed of up to 2.2GHz.
title: iQOO Z12 Lite Chipset, Design and Other Details Appear in Google Play Console Listing

description: Samsung is reportedly developing a new pair of over-ear headphones. A new leak offers a design of the purported Samsung Galaxy Studio ahead of its official launch. The renders show the device with physical volume buttons alongside a dedicated ANC toggle. The upcoming audio accessory is expected to launch in Black and Red colours.
title: Samsung Galaxy Studio Design, Colour Options Revealed in New Leak

description: Ahead of the official One UI 9.5 software release coming to various Samsung devices, a leaked unreleased Bixby 5.0 APK has revealed a new interface coming to the assistant along with a new memory retention feature. Stored memories can be saved offline (on-device) or online depending on user preferences.
title: Leaked Bixby 5.0 APK Reveals New Interface and Memory Feature For AI Assistant Ahead of One UI 9.5 Release

description: Samsung could be preparing several hardware changes for its 2028 flagship lineup. The Galaxy S28 Pro and Galaxy S28 Ultra are tipped to feature variable aperture cameras, a technology the company previously used on its Galaxy S9, Galaxy S10 and Galaxy Note 9 models. The Galaxy S28 Ultra has also been linked to a switchable 2D/3D display, while a separate report points to a slidable Samsung smartphone with a rollable OLED panel potentially arriving around the same time.
title: Samsung Galaxy S28 Series Could Bring Back Variable Aperture Cameras

description: Vivo V80 FE will be launched in select global markets soon, the company has announced. The Vivo V80 FE will sport a 6.59-inch Full-HD+ (1,260 x 2,750 pixels) AMOLED display, with up to a 120Hz refresh rate, 459 ppi pixel density, U9 light-emitting material, up to 3,000 nits peak brightness, and 100 percent DCI-P3 colour gamut. It will also ship with IP68 + IP69 ratings for dust and water resistance. The phone will be powered by a 4nm octa-core MediaTek Dimensity 7400 Turbo chipset, with four efficiency cores clocked at 2.0GHz and four performance cores, delivering a peak clock speed of 2.6GHz. The Vivo V80 FE will be backed by a 7,000mAh battery.
title: Vivo V80 FE Confirmed to Launch Soon Globally With 50-Megapixel Rear Cameras, 7,000mAh Battery

description: Apple released the iOS 27.3 Beta update for iPhone on Monday, which adds a new way to unlock the iPhone Duo. The Apple foldable, which was released in September alongside the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, brings back the Touch ID technology for biometric authentication. The Cupertino-based tech giant has also revealed that more than 200,000 apps are now optimised for the iPhone Duo. Other additions include a new Safari feature that lets Siri answer questions using webpage content and support for video podcasts in the Apple TV app.
title: iPhone Duo Gets Facial Unlocking, Close-to-Lock Feature With iOS 27.3 Beta Update

description: Star Wars: Galactic Racer is getting the much-requested local split-screen multiplayer mode early next year. Developer Fuse Games said the mode will be released as part of a Free Play mode, currently in the works at the studio. The split-screen multiplayer mode will support up to four players. Star Wars: Galactic Racer launched in October with a single-player campaign and online multiplayer.
title: Star Wars: Galactic Racer Is Getting a Local Split-Screen Multiplayer Mode in Early 2027

description: Xiaomi Smart Band 11 launched in select global markets. It features a 1.72-inch AMOLED display and is advertised to deliver up to 21 days of battery life on a single charge. It has a 233mAh Li-Po battery.  It offers heart rate monitoring and blood oxygen (SpO2) tracking. It supports over 150 sports modes. The smart band offers 5ATM water resistance and is claimed to track heart rate while swimming.
title: Xiaomi Smart Band 11 Launched With 1.72-Inch AMOLED Display, Over 150 Sports Modes: Price, Features

description: Several popular websites, including those associated with Zoom, HSBC, Equifax, CNN, Salesforce, and IKEA, were reportedly compromised to deliver malicious scripts. The code attempted to redirect cryptocurrency payments, collect credit card details, and infect iPhones. The incident comes as concerns grow over an unresolved iOS vulnerability that could expose cryptocurrency wallet credentials stored on Apple devices.
title: Hackers Compromise Popular Websites to Steal Crypto From iPhone Users

description: Google is expanding Gemini with two updates focused on voice and content creation. The app is adding 66 voices that reflect regional speech patterns across languages and variants such as Indian English and Hindi. In Gemini Notebook, users can build interactive websites from material saved in their notebooks, including study references, sales dashboards and project trackers. The new voice choices are available on Android and iOS, while interactive site creation is rolling out globally on the web for users aged 18 and above.
title: Google Gemini Update Brings 66 Regional Voices; Gemini Notebook Can Now Turn Study Notes into Interactive Websites

description: Blaupunkt Atomik Knightz 25K boombox was launched in India on Tuesday as the latest addition to the company’s portable party speaker lineup. It comes with a 120W audio output and wireless karaoke support. According to the company, the new speaker features dual 3-inch full-range drivers and a dedicated 4-inch woofer, along with a wireless microphone for karaoke sessions. It is claimed to offer up to 12 hours of playback on a single charge and supports fast charging.
title: Blaupunkt Atomik Knightz 25K Boombox Launched in India With 120W Output, Wireless Karaoke: Price, Specifications

description: Rockstar Games has shared details about the dynamic weather system in Grand Theft Auto 6 ahead of launch. The game is set to feature localised weather, bringing different weather phenomena across different regions in the game. Rockstar has also shared new screenshots showing weather-based effects in the game.
title: Rockstar Games Details Grand Theft Auto 6's New Dynamic Weather System Ahead of Launch

description: Nike unveiled a new range of footwear and apparel innovations on Monday, which span running, football, basketball, training and outdoor sports. Among the notable introductions is Tuned Air, a new manufacturing approach for Nike Air. The company has also previewed upcoming running shoes, training apparel, and signature basketball footwear, alongside an expanded range of Nike Mind products designed around athletes' sensory experiences. Nike says some of these innovations will eventually make their way into products across different sports and price segments.
title: Nike Previews New Vaporfly 5, Tuned Air Technology and Other Performance Innovations

description: Google Maps is expanding Ask Maps with features that go beyond conversational place searches. The AI tool can now put together multi-day travel itineraries, let users adjust plans through prompts and provide details such as traffic conditions and business hours. It can also find appointment slots at nearby service providers and check availability at restaurants saved to users' lists. The update is rolling out on Android and iOS, while some capabilities, including appointment searches, are initially restricted to the US.
title: Google Maps Ask Maps Gets AI-Backed Travel Planning, Appointment Search Features

description: Apple will launch the 20th anniversary iPhone model with a new camera sensor, according to a tipster. The smartphone is said to feature a 17nm logic process in the primary camera on the back. The leaker referred to the smartphone as the iPhone 20 Pro, hinting that Apple might abandon its current sequential naming scheme, similar to the strategy the company adopted for the 10th anniversary model, namely the iPhone X. This comes shortly after a purported hands-on video showing the cover glass of Apple’s 20th anniversary iPhone model surfaced online. The video suggests that the rumoured iPhone 20 Pro will be equipped with a 3D Quad-Curved Glass cover over its display.
title: Apple’s 20th Anniversary iPhone Tipped to Launch Next Year With a New Camera Sensor

description: Bitcoin traded near $64,900 on Tuesday as institutional withdrawals, declining stablecoin liquidity and expectations of another Federal Reserve rate hike weighed on cryptocurrency markets. Options traders are increasingly positioning for potential downside, with the $60,000 put option emerging as the largest open-interest position on Deribit. Meanwhile, corporate treasuries continue accumulating Bitcoin, offering some support to market sentiment.
title: Bitcoin Trades Near $65,000 as Options Traders Seek Downside Protection

description: With the launch of the Xiaomi 18 Pro series underway, Xiaomi is now said to be testing its next flagship device. Details about a regular device with a wide-screen display have emerged in the rumour mill. It will have a 6.3-6.4-inch display with a wide aspect ratio. It is suspected that this device would be the unannounced Xiaomi 18, but earlier reports also point to an affordable Redmi series device.
title: Xiaomi May Launch a Wide-Screen Phone With 6.4-Inch Display and Ultra-Thin Bezels

description: Google launched new features and tools for kids and teenagers across YouTube, Google Search, and Android in India. The new measures offer parents more control over their children's online activity. It also aims to encourage healthier screen habits among teenagers. The expansion introduces creator-led educational content and broader mental health search resources. The company has expanded the dedicated teen mental health shelves to include topics such as conduct disorder, post-traumatic stress disorder, and social anxiety disorder.
title: Google Introduces New Youth Digital Wellbeing Playlist in India, Expands Teen Mental Health Shelves

description: The Chinese edition of the Redmi Note 18 5G is tipped to have an 8,888mAh battery, marking an upgrade from the 8,000mAh cell found on its predecessor, the Redmi Note 17 5G. The global variant is said to feature an 8,100mAh pack. Wired fast-charging speeds are expected to remain unchanged at 45W in both variants, matching the Redmi Note 17 5G.
title: Redmi Note 18 5G Tipped to Feature Larger Battery Than Redmi Note 17 5G

description: Krafton India has announced a comedy-themed collaboration with Indian comedian Samay Raina as part of its upcoming 4.7 update of Battlegrounds Mobile India (BGMI). According to the developer, the partnership will see the introduction of a Samay Raina Avatar, a specially themed bus, exclusive missions, and several cosmetic rewards for players. The BGMI 4.7 update is scheduled to arrive in India on November 18, while the Samay Raina collaboration will go live on December 9.
title: BGMI 4.7 Update to Feature Samay Raina Avatar, Themed Bus and Exclusive Mission, and Special Rewards
